Flow.description: DIR-869 DOA-Routed Discount Approval. Auto-submits when a Quote in Negotiating has Discount changed ( > 0 ). Sets Pending Approval, notifies the manager (bell + email), routes: Discount <= 10% -> Sales Manager only; > 10% -> Sales Manager then RES_Finance_Team queue. Branches on the queried ApprovalWorkItem status (orchestration can't gate on an approval step's approvalDecision output). Final approve -> Approved; any reject -> Rejected + notify initiator; Recall -> Negotiating. DIR-1612: Capture_Submitted_Discount snapshots Discount/AppliedDiscountAmount at submission time; if either drifts after the Manager's decision (e.g. discount raised above 10% right after a <=10% approval), Set_Approved_Manager/Finance_Approval are blocked and Restart_Discount_Percent_Changed / Restart_Discount_Amount_Changed instead send the Quote back to Negotiating with the submission lock cleared, forcing a fresh submission and a fresh Manager approval on the real, current numbers.

Discount " & TEXT({!$Record.Discount}) & "% (Amount " & TEXT(({!$Record.Subtotal} - {!$Record.GrandTotal})) & "). Submitted by " & {!$Record.CreatedBy.FirstName} & " " & {!$Record.CreatedBy.LastName} & "."

formulas.name: fRejectBody

Move the Quote back to Negotiating when you're ready to revise and resubmit."

formulas.name: fWorkItemDesc

stageSteps.label: Notify Manager - Four Plus Rejections Warning

stageSteps.name: Restart_Discount_Percent_Changed
stageSteps.description: DIR-1612: If the Discount % was changed after the Sales Manager already made a decision (e.g. increased above 10% after a <=10% approval), don't let Finance or final sign-off proceed on a decision the Manager never actually saw - send the quote back to Negotiating so it needs a fresh submission and a fresh Manager approval.
stageSteps.label: Restart - Discount % Changed After Manager Decision

stageSteps.name: Restart_Discount_Amount_Changed
stageSteps.description: DIR-1612: Same guard as Restart_Discount_Percent_Changed, for the Discount Amount field.
stageSteps.label: Restart - Discount Amount Changed After Manager Decision
